traits.name: Acidic Flesh
traits.text:
Ranged projectiles that hit the alchemist
are dissolved and cannot be recovered.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The alchemist makes two attacks with its
claws or one with its caustic burst.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one
target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Caustic Bile
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range
15/30 ft., one target. Hit: The target must make a DC
13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) acid
damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a
successful one.
